summary: Thaw the change-set properties at the four staged write sites so a multivalued slot admits, and guard the sites mechanically.
why: A KnowledgeChangeSet freezes list values into tuples. _apply_change handed the staged graph dict(operation.properties), a shallow copy, so the tuple reached the ontology validator, which accepts only isinstance(value, list) for a multivalued slot. Every multivalued property in every population change refused at admit with STRUCTURAL_REFUSAL: Property '<name>' must be a list. The paper cell run-04 hit it on six ResearchContributor entities carrying affiliation as a one-item list; the plan and the operation both still carried the list, and the refusal came from _replay_envelopes. No earlier admitted population carried a list-valued property, which is why the defect survived. _staged_properties thaws the whole value at the four sites. _freeze, the canonical serialization and the validator are unchanged, so operations still compare and hash frozen on both sides of the population trace check. An AST guard in test_repository_guards asserts all four staged.create_* calls pass _staged_properties, because a population with no list-valued property replays either way and nothing else catches a shallow copy.
